question: Will Applied Materials' Q1 FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint be at or above $11.0 billion?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: Applied's January quarter is historically guided about flat with the October quarter, but in the current AI-driven regime guides have run 9-13% above the prior quarter's actual. The threshold needs about 5-7% sequential growth over a likely ~$10.3-10.45B Q4 actual. The 14th week mainly helps services (~20% of revenue), and holding Q4's weekly revenue flat over 14 weeks gives ~$11.04B. For: KLA guided its Dec quarter +13.5%, and FY27 consensus is ~+35%. Against: the Jan-quarter consensus is $10.74B, Lam guided only +5%, management only promised 'sequential growth', and the $510M 'Other' line may be one-off. No prediction market found.
calls.dossier:
- AMAT FY26 quarterly revenue: Q1 $7.01B (Jan 2026), Q2 $7.91B (record, May 14 2026), Q3 $9.115B (Aug 13 2026; +15% q/q, +25% y/y). Q4 guide $10.25B +/- $0.5B (Semi Systems ~$7.9B, AGS ~$1.84B, Other ~$510M). Q3 guide was $8.95B (vs Q2 actual $7.91B, +13%); Q4 guide vs Q3 actual is +12.5%. Sources: SEC 8-K exhibits, Investing.com transcript.
- Recent beats vs guide midpoint: Q3 by ~$165M; Q1 FY26 $7.01B vs Zacks $6.89B. Street expects Q4 at ~$10.30B and EPS of $4.06 (MarketBeat/preview, Nov 2026).
- Q3 call (Aug 2026): management declined to give Q1 FY27 numbers but said it expects sequential growth in Q1 FY27 and 'another strong growth year' in 2027. Q1 FY27 is a 14-week quarter; in past 14-week quarters services came close to ratable (i.e. got roughly the full extra week) and equipment much less so (Fool/Investing transcripts).
- History: January-quarter guides were roughly flat with the prior Q4 (Q1 FY25 guide ~$7.15B vs Q4 FY24 $7.05B; Q1 FY26 guide ~$6.85B vs Q4 FY25 ~$6.80B), but that was before the current growth regime.
- Consensus for the Jan 2027 quarter: Zacks $10.74B (9 estimates, high $11.20B). FY27 consensus $45.6-46.4B (+~35%). One preview: matching October's implied weekly pace over 14 weeks would take ~$11.1B.
- Peers: KLA (Oct 28 2026) guided its Dec quarter to $4.7B +/- $0.2B, +13.5% q/q from a $4.14B Sep quarter, with backlog ~$12.5B and expects WFE above $200B in 2027. Lam (Oct 21 2026) guided its Dec quarter to $8.6B +/- $0.4B, ~+5% q/q; the stock reaction was negative.
- AMAT investor day (Oct 13 2026) gave no WFE forecast; the stock fell ~24% from $497 to ~$377 by Oct 23. Needham cut its target to $580. Analysts remain bullish (Cantor, BofA).
- Prediction markets: searched Polymarket, Kalshi and Manifold — no contract on the AMAT Q1 FY27 guide found.
- Resolves off the 'Business Outlook' total revenue midpoint in AMAT's Q4 FY26 press release (Nov 12 2026), not consensus and not segment guidance. Midpoints are typically stated in $50M steps; exactly $11,000M counts as YES.
- Event window: guidance is issued on Nov 12 2026 after market close; as of Nov 2 2026 nothing has been issued (0% of the window elapsed; ~10 days to the release).
- Searched but not found: Q3 prepared-remarks text (403), any Q1 FY27 quantitative hint from the investor day, China-specific Q1 commentary, sell-side whisper numbers for the Jan guide.
